prompts.normal: Create a production pixel-art sprite atlas for a side-view 2D action RPG. References are visual references, not edit targets: first the established pixel-art Andrius idle for consistent crisp cluster rendering, second the actual normal-form full-body render for anatomy, third the gameplay glowing white phase for the phase difference. This is Andrius/Boreas: a long quadruped white wolf, huge pointed indigo mane/crown, cyan eyes and forehead gem, turquoise flank markings, ice-blue front-leg armor and crystalline ankle cuffs on hind legs, long thin curled tail with ice diamonds and three thin cyan mane streamers. Exactly four legs, canine head, no human proportions, no bipedal torso. Same character, same anatomy scale across all six slots, facing LEFT in all poses (howl head may point upward). Crisp pixel clusters, navy outline, limited cool palette, no blurred glow outside silhouette. Transparent background. Atlas 1536x1536, EXACTLY 2 columns by 3 rows with wide transparent gutters, six separated whole-body silhouettes, no clipping, no text, no frames, no scenery, no attack trails or detached sparkles. Each pose must fit its 768x512 slot with generous transparent margins. Low grounded combat stance, strong shoulder and haunch gesture; preserve four-leg support rather than stretching the idle image. NORMAL blue-mane phase, not glowing white. Six poses in reading order: (1) battle ready on four planted paws, head low; (2) forepaw swipe with one near shoulder high, near paw reaching left, other three paws supporting; (3) rear hip twist and broad curled tail sweeping behind to the right, head remains left; (4) leap tuck with front and rear paws folded under chest/haunch, fully airborne; (5) full forward running stride low long body, front paws stretched toward left, hind paws push to right, belly above ground; (6) heavy landing, both front paws firmly planted, shoulders low and hind legs compressed. Keep entire tail and ribbons inside each slot, they must not join neighboring poses.

prompts.background: Create a wide 1536x1024 pixel-art background plate for a side-view action RPG, a temporary interpretation of Wolvendom's ancient wolf trial clearing. Moonlit blue spruce forest with tall stone wolf-relief ruins, broken circular stone enclosure seen in distant side-view, cyan moonlight and sparse mist, a quiet sacred northern wolf arena in Mondstadt. No wolf, no characters, no enemies, no text, no HUD, no icons. Upper two thirds readable layered forest and ruin silhouettes with atmospheric perspective; lower third an empty unobstructed dark-blue clearing with soft low-contrast distant ground texture; no painted foreground platforms, stairs, ledges or collision objects. The actual arena floor and raised side platforms will be drawn separately by the game. Strong cool indigo/teal palette, little bright detail in the lower third so combat telegraphs remain clear. Crisp pixel-art clusters compatible with chibi character sprites, painterly depth only in distant forest, not a screenshot or a photograph.
prompts.awakened_actions: Create a production pixel-art sprite strip of Andrius/Boreas for the same side-view RPG. Reference 1 is the APPROVED AWAKENED WHITE-MANE atlas: match its exact quadruped anatomy, crisp pixel clusters, icy white mane with blue shadows, cyan eyes, white body, turquoise flank markings, hind ankle ice crystals, ice-blue foreleg guards, thin curled white tail with ice diamonds, three cyan mane streamers. Reference 2 is the normal phase pose sheet: copy ONLY its shoulder/hip gestures, do NOT copy its dark blue mane. Make EXACTLY TWO separate complete full-body sprites, in one row, 2 columns, 1536x768 or wider landscape sheet with generous transparent gutters and no overlap: LEFT: awakened forepaw swipe, one near shoulder raised and near paw reaching strongly LEFT, other three paws supporting the body. RIGHT: awakened rear-hip twist and full sweeping tail to the RIGHT behind him while his head keeps facing LEFT, four-leg grounded support. Same character and anatomy scale in both cells and matching the white-mane atlas. Full mane, tail and ribbons inside each cell, no clipping. True transparent background, no glow cloud, no detached particles, no scenery, no lettering, no frames, no human pose or bipedal torso. Key pose assets for game implementation, not concept art.
